rationale: The catalog and three verified sources consistently split each line at every vertex into two-vertex segments; multipart-to-singlepart and split-line-at-point are not equivalent.
The catalog and three verified sources split input lines or polygons at intersections with a second line or polygon-boundary layer; split-line-at-point is not equivalent.
The algorithm creates an unbounded number of output files from unique field values. The current single-chain schema cannot preserve its output cardinality or output-directory semantics.
The catalog and three verified sources produce a raster cell-distance surface to target cells; vector Buffer and vector proximity classes are not equivalent.
The catalog and three verified sources merge selected sliver polygons into adjacent polygons using area or shared-boundary rules; no stable108 topology class is equivalent.
The capability is real and source-backed, but stable108 has no Network Analysis L1/L2 branch. A single leaf must not be added before the network hierarchy boundary is reviewed.
The catalog and three verified sources create point geometry from X/Y fields and a CRS; Feature to Point requires existing geometry and is not equivalent.
